All-New Porsche 718 Boxster Gets Previewed Sans Camouflage in Fantasy Land, It's a Fresh Roadster
12 photos
Photo: sugardesign_1 / Instagram
The premium German sports car, SUV, and EV maker Porsche has recently decided to further compete with the aftermarket realm by unveiling the second generation of their discrete Dashcam model, packing high-resolution recording with HDR and many new features. But that wasn’t the most enticing recent announcement, actually.
Instead, the company has officially kicked off the teaser campaign for the second iteration of the Porsche 718 Boxster – sometime during the first quarter of 2027, the brand will unleash its first all-electric two-door sports car, the new Porsche 718. They start with the Boxster, as the roadster is always more enticing when you’re out of the woods from a tough winter, of course.
Most importantly, the company again shared some of the most important details regarding the new model, which is going to be all-electric – both the Boxster and the Cayman sibling. For example, many of the parts are inspired by the Porsche 911, and the car will retain its classic mid-engine configuration – although the company has now placed an E-Core in there rather than a boxer engine.
So, the new all-electric Porsche 718 Boxster will have the 800-volt battery pack located directly behind the car's two seats, where the ICE usually resides for this sports car application, allowing for a 40/60 weight distribution. The shared 911 parts include the steering with rear-axle setup, braking system, and the electronically controlled limited-slip differential, among others.
Porsche hasn’t offered the full numbers breakdown for the power and weight, but said the new 718 Boxster will sprint to 62 mph in less than three seconds and hit a classic top speed of 155 mph (250 kph). There’s also E-Shift, a virtual gearbox, borrowed this time from the Taycan, and a fake six-cylinder boxer engine sound borrowed from the 981-generation Boxster GTS.
As for the looks, the prototype car shown by Porsche is dressed in a funky black and white topographic map wrap featuring red accents, which conceals most of the styling. No worries, though, as the recent Porsche teaser immediately triggered the activation of a member of the imaginative guild of digital car content creators who stopped dwelling across the parallel universes of vehicular CGI and unwrapped the 718 Boxster EV.
More precisely, Sugar Chow, the virtual artist better known as " sugardesign_1 " on social media, has decided to CGI-present his vision for the all-new Porsche 718 Boxster Electric, and now it’s easy to see it in all its glory, including details like the gilled front side air intakes, the Taycan and Macan Electric or Cayenne Electric-inspired headlights, the new red and illuminated Porsche script placed between the slim LED taillights, or the new signature element on the trunk lid.
